items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: Professor Mineta was playing sax and I was playing drum... He had another son who was playing trumpet... daughter was playing banjo, Hillary, Hillary Martell.

ctx.x: Who was in the band? What were the Martell's names?

I know he had a son by the name of David Martell. He was playing trombone. And the daughter was playing banjo, Hillary, Hillary Martell. She was playing banjo and the other son was named Chester. He was playing bass. And the father? And the father was playing violin. He had another son who was playing trumpet. I just forgot his name. I can't think about his name. Professor Mineta was playing sax and I was playing drum. And we used to go to different little places like Vell Platt, little country town. Everything…
And you say it was in that band that you learned a lot from Professor Mineta?
